Title: LSJ: actions to put vampires into play

Messages.Author: Esteban
Messages.Body:
Taking the chance of embarassing myself yet again, another stupid
rules question.

Are cards like Govern the Unanligned Superior (The Call,...)
considered to be "actions to put vampires into play"? Or more
specific, would Jibade el-Bahrawi do a Superior Enchant Kindred at an
inherent +2 stealth?

The only reason I ever came up with this is because a very experienced
player told me so. My own initial answer would have been "NO".

Jibade el-Bahrawi
Clan: Ishtarri (group 4)
Capacity: 9
Disciplines: CEL DEM FOR PRE aus
Laibon: Jibade gets +1 stealth when recruiting, employing, or taking
an action to put a vampire in play. Allies and retainers cost him 1
less blood or pool.

Rarity: LoB:PI2

Thanks for helping!

Michael
